replacements.reason: ItemLink.x2C_b2 is a one-bit field. Exact GALE01 instructions load 0xF and use rlwimi with mask bit 26, which writes only the low source bit and therefore stores 1; the later non-collision path extracts that single bit, subtracts one, and writes the same bit back. Assigning true expresses the identical one-bit state transition without the host compiler's intentional-overflow diagnostic.
